topics.title: U.S. expands Latin America campaign
topics.summary: The U.S. military is seeking land-based security deals in Latin America after a year of strikes on boats it accused of carrying drugs, raising debate over regional cooperation and limits.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a big policy suddenly moves from boats to land, who in the room asks practical questions first and who starts drawing a very suspicious map?
sourceNames: Associated Press via NBC Bay Area

topics.title: National Mall grass draws attention
topics.summary: President Trump blamed vandals for brown grass near the World War II Memorial, but AP reported the area was also covered by July 4 event structures and crowds.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who would become way too invested in solving a mystery about lawn damage, and who would just recommend signs that say 'please respect the grass'?

topics.title: Korea drills scaled back
topics.summary: Trump ordered the Pentagon to reduce planned U.S.-South Korea military exercises, saying they were costly and sent the wrong signal to North Korea.
topics.discussionPrompt: If a long-planned group exercise got scaled back at the last minute, who would be relieved, and who would still insist everyone rehearse the checklist?

topics.title: Spider-Man opens huge
topics.summary: The new Spider-Man film had a massive box office debut, with The Guardian reporting it landed among the biggest opening weekends ever.
topics.discussionPrompt: Who would pretend they are above superhero hype, then somehow know every cameo, costume change, and popcorn bucket design?
